text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: AUTH_TOKEN_VALIDATION spike in prod - 401 rate at ~42% across auth gateways (eu-west-1). Pager: PD-98765

pagerduty: Trigger: AUTH_TOKEN_VALIDATION_SERVICE failure - unacked

alice oncall: ACK — taking it. I'm landing oncall box now, switching to incident channel.

jordan.sre: I'm seeing a flood of failures from auth-gateway: "error validating JWT: no matching key for kid=kp_2026_03_14_ab12". fetching JWKS from key-service returns the new key but kid mismatch on tokens in the wild.

sophia.eng-runtime: logs:
```
2026-03-14T02:12:03Z auth-gateway ERROR verifyToken failed client_id=redwood-ui error="no matching key for kid=kp_2026_03_14_ab12"
2026-03-14T02:12:04Z key-service INFO published new jwks version=2026-03-14_7
```

alice oncall: Did we rotate keys automatically via key-service? Any recent deploys?

sophia.eng-runtime: key-service deployed 02:10 UTC, it published a jwks with new kid, but some tokens issued by upstream still carry old kid and auth-gateway doesn't have the old key cached — looks like cache invalidation bug.

jordan.sre: Mitigation plan: 1) temporarily allow verification against last-known key set (legacy_kids) 2) force auth-gateway to reload JWKS from key-service 3) notify support and rate-limit token issuance until stable.

alice oncall: Rolling out jwks-reload config to canary:
```
kubectl apply -f auth-gateway/config/jwks-reload=true -n prod
kubectl rollout restart deployment/auth-gateway -n prod
```

sophia.eng-runtime: canary shows 401 -> 8% then down to 2% within 3 min after reload. Applying to all pods now.

pagerduty: Alert acknowledged by alice oncall (02:15 UTC). Escalation path: sec-team + platform-eng notified.

elaine-cs: CS notified top 10 affected customers at 02:20 UTC, created support tickets for accounts: Acme, NovaPay, Finch Labs. Triage doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1987654321

kevin: Rolling config to enable legacy_key acceptance for 10 minutes to allow session refresh: deploying patch.

sophia.eng-runtime: Patch applied. Monitoring: 401 rate dropped to 0.7% across regions. Token issuance rate back to normal.

pm-oliver: Can we get an initial customer impact stat? rough numbers?

jordan.sre: Impact window ~02:10-02:22 UTC. Peak affected requests ~42% auth failures, estimated 0.6% of overall user traffic experienced interrupted sessions. Affected zones: eu-west-1 primarily, some spillover to us-east due to routing.

alice oncall: Preparing handoff to kevin for next shift. Summary: cause JWKS cache invalidation after key-service rotation; immediate remediation: trigger JWKS reload and temporary legacy-key acceptance; follow-ups: add cache fallback, improve key rotation rollout, CR to key-service to publish both old&new for 5min.

kevin: ACK handoff. I'll keep the legacy acceptance window open for 15m and monitor logs. My phone: +1-555-0102 if needed.

sophia.eng-runtime: Follow-up ticket created: INF-4492 "JWKS rotation race -> cache miss" assigned to eng-runtime, priority P1, due EOD.

elaine-cs: Customer comms drafted and sent. No SLA breaches expected, but monitoring for escalations.

pagerduty: Incident resolved by alice oncall at 02:35 UTC - auto-close pending after 30m quiet. Final error rate baseline at 0.1%.

alice oncall: Closing notes — root cause likely race between key-service publish and auth-gateway cache eviction. Next steps: (1) key-service to publish both old & new keys for 5min during rotation, (2) auth-gateway add fallback to previous jwks, (3) add more robust monitoring + synthetic checks for token validation post-rotation. Will create follow-up PRs.

kevin: Thanks team. Handoff complete. Leaving notes in #incidents. :thumbsup:
